{{Quote|Hold on, hold on, hold on. Don't shoot. Not a rakghoul. Just a harmless shuttle pilot. Name's Melarra.|Melarra|<ref name="TOR:KUS" />}}
'''Melarra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] living during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lorrick instructed me to fly to Kaon. Rakghouls burst out of my cargo hold the second I touched down. Blood and bodies everywhere.|Melarra|<ref name="TOR:KUS" />}}
In [[3639 BBY]], Melarra was hired by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] to make a delivery from his [[Lost Island|base]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to [[Kaon]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. As it turned out, Melarra was one of the five pilots Lorrick used to spread the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] to the worlds of the Hegemony, though the pilots were unaware of it at the time. As soon as Melarra's shuttle touched down on Kaon, rakghoul burst out of the cargo hold, starting the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]]. Melarra herself managed to avoid getting infected and hid at the [[Kaon City Spaceport|spaceport]] for several days while chaos ranged outside.<ref name="TOR:KUS" />
===Death===
{{GameMechanics|option=1}}
{{Quote|Just do me a favor - don't wait too long to come and get me. I've spent more than enough time on this rock.|Melarra to members of a Republic strike team|<ref name="TOR:KUS" />}}
When a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team sent to investigate the origin of the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] made their way to the [[Kaon City Spaceport|spaceport]], Melarra came out of her hiding place and spilled everything she knew about Lorrick, asking to get her off Kaon in exchange. Republicans promised to sent a shuttle to pick her up, leaving Melarra in the spaceport to wait for it. However, before she could safely escape the planet, she was found by an Imperial strike team, looking for the same information as the Republicans before. Melarra told them what she knew as well, hoping for a similar deal, but the leader of the Imperials chose to kill Melarra instead.<ref name="TOR:KUS" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Melarra appears in [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' at the end of a Flashpoint mission "Kaon Under Siege" available to both Republic and Imperial players. Republic players have a light-side option of promising to get her off the planet, while Imperial players have a dark-side option of killing her. This article assumes that both factions chose the options of their respective alignment, meaning that Melarra was killed while waiting for a Republic shuttle.<ref name="TOR:KUS" />
